base.description: The PDU as it ships: the fixed cord and the two push-button attachments on it. The universal mounting kit, the connector lock and the mounting adaptor are not drawn.

datasheet.title: Rittal, Technical details, Power Distribution Unit (dri1308088en, 08.2023)

description: Rittal PDU basic, three-phase, 0U. A 695 mm extruded aluminium strip, 44 mm wide and about 72 mm deep, that hangs on two push-button attachments on its back. It takes a 400 V three-phase feed, 11 kW, through a 3 m fixed cord with a 16 A CEE plug. It hands that on to nine unswitched IEC C19 outlets, three on each phase. No breaker, no meter, no display, no network interface.

gaps.note: the data sheet says black anodised RAL 9005 ("other colours may be configured"); the photographs of the basic family show a natural silver extrusion and none is of this SKU. Silver is drawn.

breakers.note: datasheet - dri1308088en p.1: "No. of circuit-breakers 2 (single-phase) or 6 (3-phase) with 32 A version"; the table prints this SKU at 16 A and the sheet's feature table has the breaker "only for 32 A PDU versions", so a 16 A version has none. No breaker is drawn and none is stated.

chassis.note: drawing - length 695 (the table of page 1 prints 695 as well), width 44 (the data sheet's "44 mm (1 U)"), depth 72.1 (the side view's dimension, the body from the front face to the back). The data sheet (dri1308088en, p.1) prints "PDU enclosure depth 70 mm" and the end view 109; the 109 is the body with the cable gland standing out of the front and the button out of the back, and the 70 is the extrusion profile, as the DK 7979.175 model reads the same figures. 72.1 is drawn.

colour.note: THE DATA SHEET AND THE PHOTOGRAPHS DISAGREE. The data sheet (dri1308088en, p.1) says "Aluminium, anodised in RAL 9005 (black, other colours may be configured)"; the photographs held of the basic family show a natural silver side, and none is of this SKU. The body is drawn silver as photographed (#b9bbbe, read by eye, estimated) and the disagreement is a gap.

dcim.note: the input is one power port from the cord part and each outlet a power outlet it feeds. C19 exports as the IEC type; the CEE plug exports as `other` with a label, because no upstream type for it has been read from a held source.

front.note: drawing - the front view of page 11, mm from the foot end: the foot cell 0 to 72.1 with the gland; a blank cell to 116.4; then, for each phase, three C19 cells of about 45.5 (116.4 to 253.0, 297.3 to 433.8 and 478.4 to 614.9); a blank cell of 44.3 to 44.6 between the groups and after the last; and the head cap, 659.5 to 695, with its ribs. Each C19 stands in its cell as the DK 7979.175 model places it (long axis along the strip, earth slot toward the left of the face). Outlets count from the foot.

input.note: datasheet - dri1308088en p.1: "Input voltage range (L - N) 230 V (400 V, 3~), 50 - 60 Hz", "Input current 16 A/32 A (depending on product variant)", "No. of wires 3/5", "Connection cable type H05-VV", "Length of connection cable 3m"; the table: 3~, 16 A, 11 kW, input CEE. The circuit diagram draws the neutral to each phase group (CEE 16 A/3P + N + PE), so each outlet is line to neutral: `input-wiring: wye`. The unit has a fixed cord and no inlet. `plug-rating-a` is not written: the data sheet rates the unit, not the plug.

lifecycle.note: the maker's page lists the SKU among the 27 basic variants; no end-of-life notice was found in the pages read.

logo.note: no photograph of this SKU is held; the RITTAL mark of the basic family's renders is not drawn.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S DIMENSIONED DRAWING. Rittal, "Technical details, Power Distribution Unit, Basic version" (dri2108028en, 08.2023), PDF page 11, DK 7979.130: a plan view (the back), a side view, an end view and a front view, with the circuit diagram below. The cell lines of the front view were read from a 600 dpi render of that page at the drawing's own scale: the 695 overall length between the two ends of the front view reads 1349 px (1.941 px per mm), the same scale the DK 7979.175 page gives. Each cell edge is a full-height line of the front view. Good to about 0.5 mm. Where the DK 7979.175 model reads the same cells (the foot cell, the C19 cell, the housings) their sizes agree to within a millimetre, and its offsets of an outlet in its cell are used here.

mount.note: `rack-side`, the library's way to say a part stands vertically beside an upright, on the two push-button attachments of the plan view (dimensioned 622.3 apart, 36.1 and 36.6 in from the two ends). The data sheet's "PDU mounting options" are the enclosure frame at the side of the 482.6 mm mounting frame (zero-U space) and the cable route (push-button attachment); the mounting adaptor 7000.688 is an accessory and is not drawn. `ru: 16` is the 695 mm it runs, 695 / 44.45 = 15.6; the data sheet sells it by minimum rack height (1200 for a VX IT frame) and not by rack units.

mounting-buttons.note: drawing - the plan view of page 11: two buttons 622.3 apart (dimensioned), their centres 36.1 and 36.6 in from the two ends of the 695; plate 25.2 along the strip. The foot end of the plan view is taken to be the end of the front view's foot cell; the two positions are equal to within 0.5 mm, so the choice does not move a figure.

outlets.note: datasheet and drawing - the table of page 1 ("PDU basic"): DK 7979.130, 3~, 16 A, 11 kW, CEE input, 9 IEC C19, no IEC C13, no earthing-pin, 695 mm; the circuit diagram draws three C19 on each of L1, L2 and L3 and numbers them 1 to 9. std/c19-outlet@1. None is switched; none has a lamp. NO OUTLET NAME IS WRITTEN: no held photograph is of this SKU, so what the unit prints beside an outlet is not known, and the outlets keep their placement ids, counted from the foot.

rear.note: drawing - the plan view draws the same two long grooves, ridge and two buttons as the DK 7979.175 model reads, from 2.6 in of each end.
